Audit logs (last 7 days)
One user expected Parsec to shut down after it stopped offering paid hosting for gaming and refunded users' balances. Instead, they observed that it pivoted toward business users.
A user who tried Parsec several years ago, when it was still fairly early, said it was impressive even then.
"There's nothing out there that comes close to Parsec's performance and it'd be a huge loss" if it stopped being a standalone service.
Complaint: Parsec raised its prices after it stopped providing its gaming service. Previously the client was free and you only paid for the machine.

One user says Parsec fails badly on non-standard aspect ratios such as 32:9 and has many other failure modes. They say Parsec seemed uninterested in fixing these, leaving them marked as known issues for years. With no public source code, the user can't diagnose or fix the problems themselves.
"The remote desktop experience on Parsec is smooth and close to 60fps. I can even play games from my PC over 4G network. This is a killer solution for remote desktop."
Comparison: a user who tried both Parsec and Shadow.tech found Shadow just as good, if not a bit better.
A user describes themselves as "a big fan of the service" while congratulating the Parsec team on the acquisition.
